subject: Re: Benchmark download — request for tailored product walkthrough & calendar coordination
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@cloudvera.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Benchmark download — interested in a live walkthrough

Hi Karthik,

I downloaded the benchmark report you published last week and it raised a few questions specific to how Redwood would handle our multi-tenant inference loads (large batch scoring + low-latency features). I self-signed on the site and indicated interest in a demo but wanted to reach out directly to give you context.

High level: Cloudvera runs model scoring for about 30 customers concurrently and we need predictable token costs and the ability to pin model versions per tenant. Would love a short walkthrough that focuses on routing/fallback and cost controls.

My availability (Pacific): Tue 6/15 9–11am or Wed 6/16 2–4pm. Also, Carlos (our CTO) may join — his email is carlos.m@cloudvera.ai.

Attached is the small snapshot I exported from the benchmark tool (cloudvera-benchmark-snapshot.pdf) — it includes latency percentiles and our target QPS.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Head of ML Platforms
Cloudvera Analytics
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@cloudvera.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark download — interested in a live walkthrough

Hi Sofia — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the snapshot — that helps a lot. I’m Karthik on the SDR team; I’ll run the intake and set you up with a 30-minute tailored walkthrough with Lauren (our account executive) and one of our infra engineers if it makes sense.

Quick plan:
- I’ll propose two 30-minute slots that align with your availability.
- We’ll cover routing/fallback, per-tenant model pinning, and cost controls (30 minutes).
- I’ll include a short pre-demo checklist to speed the call.

Proposed times (all Pacific):
- Tue 6/15 9:30–10:00am
- Wed 6/16 2:30–3:00pm

Here’s a Calendly link to pick an alternate slot if those don’t work: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30?month=2027-06

I’ve attached the pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) and put the HubSpot intake on the related links so Lauren has the context. If Carlos will join, I’ll add him to the invite once you confirm.

Would you like me to lock one of the two times or do you prefer to choose via Calendly?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
SDR | Redwood Inference

Why this matters:
- Multi-tenant scoring + model pinning request (potential Dedicated or Private opportunity)
- Large concurrent QPS; they cited cost predictability as a top requirement

Suggested agenda for 30m:
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m how Redwood routes by policy + model pinning demo
- 10m batching/caching knobs + quantization recommendations for cost
- 5m next steps (POC/deep-dive + scope)

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/CLV-12987
Attachments: cloudvera-benchmark-snapshot.pdf

Let me know which slot to lock (9:30 Tue or 2:30 Wed) — I’ll send the invite and include Carlos if Sofia confirms.

Thanks,
Karthik
